ValidationRule.description: Enforce required fields for Broker Sets.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName == 'Broker_Set', OR( AND (ISBLANK(Primary_RBM__c), IsActive__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(State__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Segment__c)), ISBLANK(Aggregator__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Provide all required values for a Broker Set.
